figures.title: Four-tier system architecture.
figures.values: Schematic. Component labels reflect the deployed stack: ESP32 on ADC1/GPIO34, Firebase RTDB in asia-southeast1, FastAPI on a 512 MB tier, 27.6 MB model artifact, 60 s staleness gate.

figures.title: Data generation and training pipeline.
figures.values: Schematic. 150,000 samples, 20 crops x 19 states, 120,000/30,000 split, 400 iterations at lr 0.10.

figures.title: Independent sensor corpus: time series and marginal distributions.
figures.values: feeds.csv, 41,304 usable readings. T mean 30.9 C (range 28.6-35.5), RH mean 35.0% (range 1-63). Span 57 d, 25.8% covered; two outages shaded, trace broken not interpolated.

figures.title: Synthetic training space against measured readings, T-RH plane.
figures.values: 6,000 synthetic samples vs every 12th sensor reading. Pearson r(T,RH) = 0.130 in the measured corpus.

figures.title: Top-1 accuracy by classifier.
figures.values: Gaussian NB 58.17% | Logistic Reg. 58.50% | Decision Tree 84.24% | k-NN (k=15) 88.56% | Extra Trees 85.29% | Random Forest 85.81% | HistGB 87.57%

figures.title: Accuracy against serialised artifact size, with the 512 MB deployment ceiling.
figures.values: Gaussian NB 0.00 MB | Logistic Reg. 0.00 MB | Decision Tree 6.84 MB | k-NN (k=15) 11.28 MB | Extra Trees 2481.59 MB | Random Forest 999.97 MB | HistGB 27.61 MB

figures.title: Per-class F1 with precision and recall overlaid.
figures.values: macro-F1 0.8754. Best: Kale 1.000, Coriander 0.994. Worst: Pea 0.736, Strawberry 0.770. Support 1,500 per class.

figures.title: Row-normalised confusion matrix over 20 classes.
figures.values: Held-out set n = 30,000; row-normalised recall, cells below 4% suppressed. Overall accuracy 87.57%.

figures.title: Cumulative feature ablation with a +/-1 CV SD noise band.
figures.values: n=4 87.42% -> n=6 87.55% -> n=7 87.44% -> n=9 87.57%. Total gain +0.15 pp against CV SD 0.15 pp: within noise.

figures.title: Training and held-out accuracy against corpus size.
Reliability diagram for the deployed model.
figures.values: ECE 0.0494; mean predicted confidence 0.9251 against realised accuracy 0.8757. Bins with n <= 30 dropped.

figures.title: Per-class F1 against cumulative agronomic-profile overlap.
figures.values: Overlap computed from CROP_PROFILES alone, no model output. r(overlap, F1) = -0.975; r(pairwise overlap, off-diagonal confusion) = 0.973.

figures.title: Amortised per-sample inference cost, single-threaded.
figures.values: HistGB batch 1 333.1 ms -> batch 512 3.47 ms/sample. k-NN batch 1 5.56 ms. Multi-threaded batch 1 was 1096 ms (thread-pool overhead, discarded).
